How I handle design

I follow the design thinking process, so every screen starts from a real user problem.

  1. 1

    Empathize

    I talk to users and study how people use similar products, so I understand what frustrates them before I draw anything.

  2. 2

    Define

    I turn what I learned into one clear problem statement and a short list of user needs.

  3. 3

    Ideate

    I sketch many options, map the user flows and pick the strongest direction.

  4. 4

    Prototype

    I build wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma so ideas can be seen and tried early.

  5. 5

    Test

    I put the prototype in front of real users, watch where they struggle and improve the design.

Testing often sends me back to an earlier step. I repeat the loop until the product feels simple to use.

About me

I’m a user-focused designer and product thinker. I like solving real problems with clean, intuitive interfaces that balance usability, strategy and visual clarity.

I’m also a computer engineering student, so I think about how a product gets built, not only how it looks. That helps me design things that are realistic to ship.

Questions and answers

The things people ask me most.

What kind of projects do you work on?

I design mobile apps, dashboards and landing pages, and I also make graphics such as flyers, social media posts and YouTube thumbnails.

Are you available for freelance work?

Yes. I’m open to freelance projects and full-time roles.

How long does a project take?

It depends on the size of the project. A set of graphics can take a few days, while a full app or dashboard design takes longer. I’ll give you a clear timeline once I understand what you need.

Can we work together remotely?

Yes. I’m based in Lagos and work with clients remotely, using Figma for design and WhatsApp or email to stay in touch.

How do I get started?

Send me a message on WhatsApp or email and tell me about your project and goals. I’ll reply with the next steps.

Let’s Talk

Have a product, brand or project in mind? Message me on WhatsApp or send an email and tell me what you need.
